name: Landratsamt Landkreis Kronach Rechenzentrum
notes: School privacy notice states technical operation of data-processing systems is generally handled by the Landratsamt data center in Landkreis Kronach; public technical details and capacity not found.

name: Klinikum Kulmbach green data center modernization
notes: BMU-sourced report says Klinikum Kulmbach planned a data center modernization/server virtualization pilot, supported with about EUR 50,000, reducing power use by 76,000 kWh/year; current completion status not verified from public sources.

name: BayCIX Landshut data center
notes: BayCIX service page states it operates its own data centers in Munich and Landshut, with partners in Regensburg and Frankfurt; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: HostSpezial Lichtenfels Rechenzentrum
notes: HostSpezial states it has its own ISO 27001 data center in Lichtenfels and provides managed IT, backup, hybrid cloud, and hosting from the Lichtenfels RZ; capacity not disclosed.

name: Landratsamt Lichtenfels former vaccination-center data center
notes: Main-Post reports the district committee approved conversion of Gabelsbergerstrasse 22/24 into a Landratsamt branch with offices and a data center; public source does not state size or MW.

name: Datacenter Bodensee
notes: Stadtwerke Lindau business page markets Datacenter Bodensee with server hosting/housing, storage, IT outsourcing, hosted services, managed services, Exchange and Office 365 services at Auenstrasse 12, Lindau; capacity not disclosed.

name: accompio / PCK IT Datacenter Lindau
developer: accompio SmarTec GmbH / PCK IT Datacenter GmbH
notes: accompio states it operates its own data centre in Lindau; PCK/accompio page says PCK IT Solutions and PCK IT Datacenter became part of accompio and that the Lindau datacenter operates IT-as-a-Service/managed services with renewable power; capacity not disclosed.

name: Klinikum Main-Spessart new data center
notes: Klinikum Main-Spessart says its IT team put a new data center into operation in autumn 2020 as the foundation for further digital modernization; capacity not disclosed.

name: Stadt Memmingen administrative data center HCI refresh
notes: EU TED notice for Stadt Memmingen covers procurement of a hyperconverged server/storage/backup solution to renew its data center and replace the current administrative server farm; performance place is Memmingen, contract period 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-31.
